datasets.name: k_rows
datasets.query: SELECT r.run_key, r.run_id, r.provider, r.backend, r.mode, r.corpus, k.theorem, k.variant, k.ref_id, k.valid, k.primary_null_model, k.tau_agent, k.tau_blind, k.K FROM k_reference_score k JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) JOIN runs r USING(run_key) JOIN job_context jc ON jc.ref_id = k.ref_id ORDER BY r.provider NULLS LAST, r.run_id NULLS LAST, k.theorem, k.variant

datasets.name: k_summary_by_provider_mode
datasets.query: WITH base AS ( SELECT r.provider, r.mode, k.valid, k.K FROM k_reference_score k JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) JOIN runs r USING(run_key) JOIN job_context jc ON jc.ref_id = k.ref_id ) SELECT provider, mode, count(*) AS k_rows, sum(CASE WHEN valid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_rows, avg(CASE WHEN valid THEN K ELSE NULL END) AS k_mean_valid, stddev_samp(CASE WHEN valid THEN K ELSE NULL END) AS k_std_valid FROM base GROUP BY provider, mode ORDER BY provider NULLS LAST, mode NULLS LAST

datasets.name: reference_meta
datasets.query: SELECT ref_id, kind, created_at, meta, artifact_path FROM lake_references WHERE ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM job_context) ORDER BY ref_id
